1.consolidated_definition: Frigorífico, nevera. Aparato que sirve para mantener frío lo que tiene dentro, especialmente los alimentos. Frecuente. DRAE: desde 1970. En el mercado existen varias marcas que se han dedicado a crear este tipo de refrigerador (El Nuevo Día, 24-10-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Refrigerator, freezer. An appliance that serves to maintain coldness within it, especially food items. Frequent. (From the Royal Spanish Academy Dictionary since 1970.) In the market, various brands have dedicated themselves to creating this type of refrigeration unit (The New Day, October 24, 2006).
